title: DEMISE OF THE FISHING ENTHUSIAST
description: Paata was killed when visitng Gio's house. Determine the culprit, weapon, and location.
incidentReport: Four friends - Gio, Paata, Gvanca and Ania - gathered at Gio's place to play Monopoly. Unfortunately, Paata was murdered right before he won. Detectives believe that either Poisoned Coffee, Communism or Paata's Fishing Rod was used to murder Paata. The following locations were examined: Living Room, Balcony and Gio's Room.

interviews.speaker: Gio
interviews.statement: Bro, they're saying that I hit Paata in head with his Fishing Rod. It's bullshit. Ma man Kako can attest to that.

interviews.speaker: Gvanca
interviews.statement: I saw Ania poisoning the coffee when Paata started winning the game. Why am I exposing my own sister? Because everyone is all the same to me, and she definitely isn't special.

interviews.speaker: Ania
interviews.statement: Well, Gio certainly was not in his room, since Kako and Gveni were screaming at the top of their lungs, calling for him.

clues: The suspect holding the heaviest weapon was seen carelessly waving it around outdoors.
The overthinker was heard having a nihilistic monologue in the Living Room.
